theorems.statement: ∀ {α : Type} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α) (S : Set α) (v : ℕ → α → ℝ) (w h : α → ℝ) (A B M : ℝ), MeasurableSet S → 0 ≤ B → (∀ k, IntegrableOn (v k) S μ) → IntegrableOn w S μ → AEStronglyMeasurable h (μ.restrict S) → (∀ x ∈ S, |h x| ≤ M) → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ x in S, |v k x - w x| ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 0) → (∀ k, |∫ x in S, v k x * h x ∂μ| ≤ A + B * ∫ x in S, |v k x| ∂μ) → |∫ x in S, w x * h x ∂μ| ≤ A + B * ∫ x in S, |w x| ∂μ
